analysis: Examined the head text of MultiModelBatchSchedulerEngine.swift (lines 527-1685) and the patch for MultiModelBatchSchedulerEngineError.swift. Changed behavior: (1) the GLM media path now rejects withheld-output modes (required/named tool_choice or JSON response_format) with a 4xx invalidToolPayload, and calls releaseBox.fire() before throwing, so the model pin is not leaked. (2) Text-path streaming sets nativeReasoningPrefix for GLM when output is withheld, and makeEventStream adds a GLM JSON-answer withholding emit() wrapper. In that wrapper, glmAnswer.withholding(routed) gates visible events, and glmAnswer.validatedAnswer(finishReason:) yields only after successful validation. On a validation error the stream finishes with a throw and releaseBox.fire(). The removed-looking validation on the router.streamsToolCalls branch uses formatOutput?.observe, not glmAnswer. That branch bypasses glmAnswer, but it is auto-only streamed calls and GLM withholding applies to required/named/JSON modes, so I did not establish a bypass. This is an integration question about whether router.streamsToolCalls can be true for GLM withheld modes. (3) A new .unsupportedOutputControl error case maps to a deterministic 400 via a prefix match on lowercased messages from EngineV2Translation.unsupportedOutputControlPrefix. The prefix is defined outside the supplied evidence. If the string is mismatched, requests fall to a 500 and could trip the coordinator's breaker. This is an availability matter, not a demonstrated regression. Media reservation, release, deadline checks and cancel paths look consistent, with release on every exit (mediaGate.release is idempotent). Media prefix-cache identity binding (hybridPrefixIdentity) is unchanged from the T-041 posture, and cacheScope is passed from the coordinator-authored requestCacheScope. The native MiMo media path passes cacheScope (not requestCacheScope) with cacheEnabled:false, so no cache exposure. No changes to the keys, attestation or authorization surface, and no new at-rest artifacts. Remaining questions for integration: the EngineV2Translation prefix constant, and GLM5NextResponseFormatOutput behavior (not supplied).
